content: Diabetes technology is classified into two primary categories. 1. Insulin Administration Devices: These include tools such as syringes, insulin pens, patch devices, and insulin pumps. Insulin pumps, specifically Continuous Subcutaneous Insulin Infusion (CSII) systems, deliver insulin in a controlled and continuous manner under the skin. 2. Monitoring Devices: These consist of Blood Glucose Monitoring (BGM) systems and Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) systems. BGM devices measure blood glucose levels at specific points in time, while CGM systems provide continuous, real-time data on glucose levels, offering valuable insights into glucose trends and fluctuations.
